description: Duration unit conversion and aggregation validation
unit_policy: duration_min is already in MINUTES per Phase 1. No further conversion needed.
to_seconds_derivation: duration_sec = duration_min * 60 (only in derived data, not source)

invalid_duration_policy.extreme_outliers: excluded from aggregation (>30 min), counted separately

note: Source values confirmed from CSV samples: 5.1767, 4.7782, 2.8411 minutes — realistic song lengths
